product.seoTitle: P-Line CXX US Package Diameters & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
product.metaDescription: Verified US Moss Green CXX 10 and 12 lb package-label diameters and 300-yard lengths, with reel-capacity estimates and backing guidance.
product.quickSummary: CXX X-Tra Strong is P-Line's copolymer main line. This US package-label reference covers Moss Green CXXFG 10 and 12 lb in 300-yard cartons. The photos do not establish a production year or the newest edition; other CXX colors and packages are not covered.
product.suitabilityTitle: CXX: check diameter as well as pound test
product.suitabilitySummary: P-Line positions CXX for demanding cover and shock loading. That is manufacturer positioning, not an independent performance test. The pictured 10 lb line is .014 inch and the 12 lb is .0148 inch, so plan the reel fill with the exact label rather than a generic 10 or 12 lb mono rating. Rod range, lure weight, cover, and drag still determine an appropriate strength.
product.chartNote: US Moss Green cartons only: CXXFG-10, 10 lb, .014 in/.35 mm, 300 yd; CXXFG-12, 12 lb, .0148 in/.37 mm, 300 yd. Production dates are unestablished. Both diameters are independently printed values, not measurements or retailer-authored chart entries.
product.chartCaption: Pictured US CXXFG package specifications; not a complete range or current-stock list.
product.sourceNote: Manufacturer-printed carton labels were visually inspected in the original Fishing Addiction Gear photos. P-Line's US variant records independently match model number, color, strength, and yard count, but do not publish numeric diameters. The cartons print 273 m beside 300 yd; the official dropdown says 300YD/247M. This reference retains the explicit 300 yd count, not an inferred metric package.
product.reviewNote: Specification-based guidance for these two Moss Green packages only. No claim of measured abrasion resistance, breaking strength, or casting superiority.
strengthGuide: The verified choices are 10 and 12 lb, not every intervening or heavier CXX strength. Use the rod and fishing conditions to choose between suitable options, then check capacity.
The .0148-inch 12 lb carton should not be rounded to a different retailer diameter. A small diameter difference changes the amount of line that fits.
Crystal Clear CXXFC and quarter-pound CXXQC packages are separate identities. A length shown for one of those packages does not extend this Moss Green filler reference.

spoolingGuide.title: One 300-yard package, several possible fills
spoolingGuide.text: First determine how much working CXX your fishing requires. A 300-yard carton may supply more than one short working fill, but reserve line for casts, runs, retying, and any damaged section you remove.

spoolingGuide.title: Backing can reduce the working fill
spoolingGuide.text: Backing occupies the space below the CXX you intend to fish. Keep its joining knot below the working section, wind evenly, and stop at the reel maker's recommended fill level.

spoolingGuide.title: Main line is not a leader specification
spoolingGuide.text: These are CXX mainline cartons. A separate leader is an independent tackle choice; its diameter, length, and knot should not be inferred from the CXX package.

faqs.question: Which CXX packages do these numbers describe?
faqs.answer: Only US Moss Green CXXFG-10 and CXXFG-12, each labeled 300 yards. Other colors, bulk lengths, and production editions are not verified by these photos.

faqs.question: Is this a current CXX availability chart?
faqs.answer: No. These are legible, undated production-label photos with matching official US identities. The page does not establish manufacturing year, current stock, or an unchanged latest formulation.

faqs.question: Why is 12 lb shown as .0148 inch?
faqs.answer: That is the value printed on the photographed CXXFG-12 carton, alongside .37 mm. It is preserved rather than replaced by a rounded retailer value.

faqs.question: Does 300 yards mean the reel should take all of it?
faqs.answer: No. Package length is the amount supplied, not the reel's capacity. Match the line diameter to the reel's rating and leave the recommended clearance at the spool lip.

product.seoTitle: P-Line FloroClear US Label Diameters & Capacity | ReelCalc
product.metaDescription: P-Line FloroClear US label reference: historical 2021 10 lb/600 yd and pictured 12 lb/300 yd specifications, reel capacity, and package differences.
product.quickSummary: FloroClear is a fluorocarbon-coated copolymer, not 100% fluorocarbon. This US reference combines a historical 2021 catalog label for Clear 10 lb/600 yd with a photographed Clear 12 lb/300 yd filler package of unestablished production year. It is not a current-edition or stock claim.
product.suitabilitySummary: FloroClear is an option when the intended main line is a coated copolymer rather than a full fluorocarbon or braid construction. P-Line identifies a silicone treatment; no independent handling advantage is claimed here. Check the exact filler or bonus package before planning capacity, because the inspected 12 lb packages do not print identical inch diameters.
product.chartNote: US Clear only: 2021 catalog p.9 FCCBF-10, 10 lb, .0116 in/.29 mm, 600 yd; undated pictured FCCF-12 filler, 12 lb, .0124 in/.31 mm, 300 yd. The separate 12 lb/600 yd FCCBF bonus label prints .0122 in and is NOT combined into the 12 lb filler row.
product.chartCaption: 2021 US 10 lb bonus label and undated US 12 lb filler label; package-specific historical/reference data.
product.sourceNote: The 10 lb numbers come from the manufacturer's official 2021 US catalog, printed page 9. The 12 lb filler values are visible on an actual P-Line carton and matching spool in an eBay-hosted photo, with UPC 015789650070. Official US variants corroborate FCCBF-10 and FCCF-12 identities. Seller prose and retailer diameter tables are not numeric authority. Neither row establishes current edition or availability.
product.reviewNote: A source-based mainline reference, not a test of visibility, castability, knot strength, or the condition of older stock.
strengthGuide: The 10 lb and 12 lb entries have different verified package lengths: 600 and 300 yards respectively. Select the strength for the rod and fishing conditions, then plan the working length from that exact package.
A 12 lb FCCBF bonus carton is not interchangeable with the FCCF filler for this chart. Its .0122-inch label remains separate from the filler's .0124-inch label.
The historical 10 lb specification describes a labeled product, not the fitness of any old spool. Storage and physical condition require a separate check.

spoolingGuide.title: Keep the filler and bonus packages separate
spoolingGuide.text: The supported 12 lb working-line budget starts from 300 yards; the historical 10 lb package starts from 600 yards. Do not give the 12 lb filler an extra 300 yards simply because a bonus package exists.

spoolingGuide.title: Plan a usable working section
spoolingGuide.text: Leave sufficient FloroClear for casts, fish runs, and retying. Backing may occupy unused space below it, with the joining knot kept outside the expected working section.

spoolingGuide.title: Treat the coating as construction, not a leader
spoolingGuide.text: The fluorocarbon coating does not make this a separate fluorocarbon leader material. Add a leader only when the presentation calls for one and account separately for a long topshot.

faqs.question: Is FloroClear 100% fluorocarbon?
faqs.answer: No. P-Line identifies FloroClear as fluorocarbon-coated copolymer and describes a silicone treatment. It remains a Copolymer mainline record here.

faqs.question: Why is the 10 lb entry dated 2021?
faqs.answer: Its readable diameter and 600-yard label are in the official 2021 US catalog, printed page 9. The source is historical; the entry does not claim current production or availability.

faqs.question: Can I use the 12 lb row for a 600-yard bonus pack?
faqs.answer: Not from this evidence. The inspected FCCBF-12 bonus carton prints .0122 in/.31 mm, while the FCCF-12 300-yard filler prints .0124 in/.31 mm. This chart retains only the filler package for 12 lb.

faqs.question: Does the same pound test always give the same capacity?
faqs.answer: No. Capacity depends on diameter and how the line packs, not only the strength label. Match the exact product and package specification rather than treating all 12 lb lines as equivalent.

product.seoTitle: P-Line CX Premium US Diameters & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
product.metaDescription: Verified US Moss Green CX Premium 6 and 8 lb carton diameters and 300-yard packages, with capacity estimates and coated-copolymer spooling guidance.
product.quickSummary: CX Premium combines copolymer with a fluorocarbon-silicone coating. This US reference covers the photographed Moss Green CXFMG 6 and 8 lb, 300-yard cartons. Their production years are unestablished; the labels do not establish a current edition or stock position. CX Premium is not CXX X-Tra Strong.
product.suitabilityTitle: A coated main line for a measured spool plan
product.suitabilitySummary: CX Premium is a coated-copolymer mainline option, with P-Line discussing both spinning and baitcasting use. The supported 6 and 8 lb packages let you compare .0084 and .0092 inch diameters without borrowing the specifications of CXX or Clear Fluorescent CX. Choose an appropriate rod and lure combination first; a larger capacity estimate is not a reason to use a lighter line than the fishing needs.
product.chartNote: US Moss Green CXFMG cartons only: 6 lb, .0084 in/.21 mm, 300 yd; 8 lb, .0092 in/.23 mm, 300 yd. Manufacturer-printed labels were read directly from actual package photos. The photos have no established production year; no other strength, color, or regional package is included.
product.chartCaption: Undated US CXFMG 6 and 8 lb package-label references, not a current full-range chart.
product.sourceNote: Actual eBay-hosted CX Premium carton photographs supply the numeric values. Official P-Line US model numbers CXFMG-6 and CXFMG-8 independently match the color, strength, and 300-yard package. The current generic 300YD/247M option contains a metric discrepancy and is not used to infer a meter-rated package. Retailer-authored diameters are excluded.
product.reviewNote: Specification-based guidance only. P-Line's handling and stretch claims are not independently tested here.
strengthGuide: The selected 6 lb CXFMG label prints .0084 inch; the 8 lb label prints .0092 inch. Use those actual values rather than a generic copolymer diameter for the same pound test.
Both accepted cartons contain 300 yards. No bulk or other-color package is silently added to either row.
A lighter line can increase estimated capacity while changing the demands on drag setting and handling. The capacity result does not establish that 6 lb suits the target fish or cover.

spoolingGuide.title: Check the exact CX carton
spoolingGuide.text: The accepted packages say CX Premium, CXFMG, Moss Green, and 300 yards. CXX and other CX colors are separate source identities even when their packaging looks similar.

spoolingGuide.title: Use backing only below the working line
spoolingGuide.text: For a shorter working fill, allow enough CX for the cast, reserve, and retying, then use backing for the remaining spool volume. Keep the join below the expected working section.

spoolingGuide.title: Stop at the physical fill level
spoolingGuide.text: Wind under even tension and follow the reel maker's fill guidance. The .0084- and .0092-inch labels support calculated estimates, not a promise that every reel will accept the exact predicted yardage.

faqs.answer: No. CX Premium is the coated copolymer identified by the CXFMG cartons here. CXX X-Tra Strong is a separate P-Line product and must use its own specification.

faqs.answer: Only US Moss Green CXFMG 6 and 8 lb in 300-yard cartons. Clear Fluorescent, other strengths, and regional lengths are not established by these photos.

spoolingGuide.title: Secure the braid at the arbor

spoolingGuide.title: Choose the leader separately

product.seoTitle: P-Line TCB 8 Teflon-Label Diameters & Capacity | ReelCalc
product.metaDescription: US Teflon-labeled TCB 8 package reference: Green 20 lb/150 yd and Yellow 50 lb/300 yd, with 2021 catalog identity and diameter-based capacity.
product.construction: 8-strand braid; pictured Teflon Surface Protector version
product.quickSummary: US Teflon-label reference: Green TCB 8 20 lb/150 yd and Hi Vis Yellow 50 lb/300 yd. The official 2021 US catalog connects X-Braid, XTCB-8, and this Teflon-labeled family. The photos have no established production year; this page does not assert the current Slick Coat formulation is identical or that these packages are available now.
product.suitabilityTitle: Match the Teflon-labeled version before comparing capacity
product.suitabilitySummary: The accepted TCB 8 labels document an eight-strand braid at two very different strengths and diameters: 20 lb at .010 inch and 50 lb at .014 inch. They are not a complete range or interchangeable recommendations. Choose for the rod, cover, and presentation first. A name match to today's X-Braid page does not establish unchanged coating or an equivalent current edition.
product.chartNote: US Teflon-labeled packages only: Green PXB8150-20, 20 lb, .010 in/.25 mm, 150 yd; Hi Vis Yellow PXBY8300-50, 50 lb, .014 in/.36 mm, 300 yd. Official 2021 US catalog p.4 corroborates this family's names and package identities. It does not date these photographs or verify current Slick Coat specifications.
product.chartCaption: US Teflon-version label references, linked to 2021 catalog identity; no current-edition or stock claim.
product.sourceNote: The numeric authority is actual P-Line TCB 8 spool printing in Tackle Warehouse-hosted photos. The official 2021 US catalog, page 4, explicitly links X-Braid/XTCB-8, eight strands, Teflon Surface Protector, and PXB/PXBY package families. The current X-Braid Green page is retained as identity context only because it now says Slick Coat. No other strengths or shared package lengths are inferred.
product.reviewNote: No assertion that historical Teflon-labeled TCB 8 and present Slick Coat are the same formulation. This is not a casting, abrasion, or strength test.
strengthGuide: The verified choices are 20 and 50 lb only; the gap does not imply that intermediate strengths were discontinued or never sold.
Keep Green 20 lb paired with its 150-yard label and Hi Vis Yellow 50 lb with its 300-yard label. Neither package size is copied across strengths.
Compare the exact diameter and use an appropriate drag and rod setup. The 50 lb package is not a substitute for a 20 lb package merely because both say TCB 8.

spoolingGuide.title: Check a 150-yard working-line budget
spoolingGuide.text: For the supported Green 20 lb package, leave sufficient braid for casts, runs, and retying before allocating the remaining spool space to backing. A large capacity estimate does not create more than the 150 yards supplied.

spoolingGuide.title: Treat the 300-yard Yellow package separately
spoolingGuide.text: The verified Hi Vis Yellow 50 lb spool supplies 300 yards. Wind with consistent tension and follow the reel's fill guidance instead of assuming the full package belongs on a single reel.

spoolingGuide.title: Separate arbor attachment from the leader
spoolingGuide.text: A reel-approved braid attachment or suitable mono base addresses spool-arbor slip. A leader is a different section near the lure; a long topshot requires a separate space allowance.

faqs.question: Why are TCB 8, XTCB-8, and X-Braid linked here?
faqs.answer: The official 2021 US catalog explicitly connects those names with the eight-strand Teflon Surface Protector family and the matching PXB/PXBY model codes. The identity is not inferred solely from a retailer title.

faqs.question: Is this the current Slick Coat version?
faqs.answer: No such equivalence is established. This page is explicitly for the pictured US Teflon-labeled packages; the present official X-Braid page uses Slick Coat wording.

faqs.question: Were these exact photographs taken in 2021?
faqs.answer: Their production and photography dates are unestablished. The 2021 US catalog supplies historical identity and package corroboration, not a date for the photos or a current availability claim.

faqs.question: Are 150 and 300 yards available for every listed strength?
faqs.answer: That is not verified here. The accepted Green 20 lb label is 150 yards; the accepted Hi Vis Yellow 50 lb label is 300 yards. Other package combinations remain outside the chart.
